Name: Qmorning's-Seasonal-Shane
Author: Qmorning123456
Description:
!!!我目前已经很少游玩这个游戏，再三思索决定开放权限，大家可以随意编辑，这样喜爱这个作品的玩家或许可以等到其他人的更新，感谢各位喜欢这个作品！
!!! I've rarely played this game at the moment.,After thinking twice, I decided to open the permission.,You can edit it at will.,So that players who love this work may be able to wait for other people's updates.,Thank you for liking this work!

使用须知：
请先把季节可爱角色的shane删掉（肖像和行走图），然后再导入我为季节性可爱角色制作的文件❗️❗️直接把我压缩包里的文件二选一（新版/旧版，总之选你有的！文件名长得和你下载的一样就行）拖进去就可以，目的是解决谢恩悬崖剧情的贴图
行走图和肖像是独立于季节性可爱角色的，如果您不介意悬崖剧情看原版游戏的贴图（可能会造成观感下降）只拖我的mod（qmorningseasonalshane）也可以

Instructions for use:
Please delete the shane of the seasonal cute character first（both characters and portraits）, and then import the file I made for the seasonal cute character ❗ ️ ❗ Simply drag one of the files that you have in my compressed folder (new/legacy version) into it, the purpose is to solve the texture problem of the Shane Cliff plot
The walking image and portrait are independent of seasonal cute characters. If you don't mind watching the original game's textures for the cliff plot (which may cause a decrease in viewing experience), you can just drag my mod (qmorningseasonalshane)
